title: Battery status list in Telegram
goal: "stato batterie" in Telegram answers with the formatted list the CLI prints
acceptance: Test: the phrase returns the same lines as `nerv batteries status`, in Italian or English, without a model call
privacy: Owner fleet and kitchen data stay local-only; tests use invented batteries, drones and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-20: route one phrase to the existing formatter. Not a measurement.
